title: The Social Laboratory: A Psychometric Framework for Multi-Agent LLM Evaluation
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measured the emergent social and cognitive dynamics (e.g., consensus-seeking, semantic convergence) of LLM agents during debates on challenging and controversial topics, which included religion.
findings: The study found that LLM agents have a robust tendency to seek consensus, and this cooperative behavior does not statistically degrade when discussing sensitive or contentious topics, which included religion. The agents' performance and tendency to converge remained stable regardless of topic sensitivity.
